comment: target = copies of each card in the post-board list for the matchup; a deck cuts max(0, have - target) and brings in max(0, target - have). 'out' is ordered from the first card to cut to the last; 'in' from the first card to bring in to the last (copies = explicit moves of the reference list, 0 = implied or filler). Re-order freely (drag and drop in the dashboard); order is the ranking.
